limitations: Main-process CPU excludes its controlled workload child; the child can remain CPU-active despite zero Tasks.
Docker/cgroup data aggregates this Agent container, including that child; it is not main-process idle CPU/RSS or helper-container usage.
VmHWM is since process start and cgroup memory.peak since cgroup creation, not a reset 60-second-window peak.
Docker stats CPU and rolling PSI are endpoint snapshots; cgroup CPU uses its own measured elapsed span.
Only zero Tasks at before/after boundaries is proven; no continuous DB observation or production SLA is asserted.
